description: A small round zen garden dish filled with white sand sits on the tabletop, with a tiny figurine in the center and a small stone near the rim, and a yellow mini rake is nearby. The left hand holds the rim of the dish steady as a left-hand object while the right hand brings the yellow rake to the sand, drags it along the lower edge and then up toward the upper-left rim to smooth and refresh the grooves, then lifts the rake away and sets it above the dish.
